metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature, captured with MODIS Terra, in New York higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Terra Land Surface Temperature (LST) product: MODIS/006/MOD11A2 (8-day composite) - Need two time periods: July 20-27, 2016 and July 20-27 average for 2001-2010 - Location: New York City area - Band: LST_Day_1km (daytime LST) 2. Masking strategy: - Use QC band to mask poor quality pixels - LST is in Kelvin, need to convert or compare directly - The question is about temperature, not clouds, so mask low quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid temperature should be in reasonable range (e.g., 250-330K for summer) - Zero would be invalid for LST - Need to check pixel counts after masking - Compare 2016 value vs 2001-2010 average ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nyc = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0060, 40.7128]); const region = nyc.buffer(20000); // 20km radius around NYC // MODIS 8-day composite: need to find the composite covering July 20-27 // MOD11A2 composites every 8 days starting from a reference date const target2016Start = '2016-07-20'; const target2016End = '2016-07-27'; const baseline2001Start = '2001-07-20'; const baseline2001End = '2001-07-27'; const baseline2010Start = '2010-07-27'; const baseline2010End = '2010-08-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2'); // Get 2016 data const lst2016 = modis .filterDate(target2016Start, target2016End) .filterBounds(region) .select('LST_Day_1km'); console.log('2016 Collection size:', lst2016.size().getInfo()); if (lst2016.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No data for 2016 July 20-27.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get 2001-2010 baseline (all years, same period) const lstBaseline = ee.ImageCollection( ee.List.sequence(2001, 2010).map(function(year) { return modis .filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 20), ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 28)) .filterBounds(region) .select('LST_Day_1km') .mean(); }) ); console.log('Baseline years collection size:', lstBaseline.size().getInfo()); if (lstBaseline.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No baseline data for 2001-2010.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing const img2016 = lst2016.mean().multiply(0.02); // Scale factor to Kelvin const imgBaseline = lstBaseline.mean().multiply(0.02); // Check pixel counts const count2016 = img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const countBaseline = imgBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log('2016 valid pixels:', count2016); console.log('Baseline valid pixels:', countBaseline); if (count2016 === 0 || countBaseline === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean temperatures const temp2016 = img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const tempBaseline = imgBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log('2016 July 20-27 LST (K):', temp2016 ? temp2016.toFixed(2) : 'null'); console.log('2001-2010 baseline LST (K):', tempBaseline ? tempBaseline.toFixed(2) : 'null'); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (temp2016 === null || tempBaseline === null || temp2016 < 250 || temp2016 > 350 || tempBaseline < 250 || tempBaseline > 350) { console.log('Invalid temperature values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const diff = temp2016 - tempBaseline; console.log('Temperature difference (2016 - baseline):', diff.toFixed(2), 'K'); if (temp2016 > tempBaseline) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
